FAQs

Event screen questions

Can't see your answer? Call 1300 SIGN HIRE.

Where can you set up a screen?

Almost anywhere. We deliver and install Australia-wide, no job too big or too small. Placement depends on the location, visibility and power if required.

Are the screens weatherproof?

Yes. Our screens are IP65 rated for heat, rain and wind, and stay crisp and clear in direct sunlight.

How long can a screen run for?

Up to 24 hours a day. Solar media screens are self-powered, Media 5u has a generator option and modular panels run on onsite power.

How much does event screen hire cost?

Rates depend on location, screen size, specifications and hire length (short, medium or long). Contact us for a free quote.

How can I pay?

Credit card, direct deposit or cash, depending on your preference and agreement with us.
